# Cappella Embassy Kuala Lumpur, formerly D'Rapport Residences (www.d-rapport.com)

> Sales landing page for Cappella Embassy, a completed low-density luxury condominium in Ampang Hilir, Kuala Lumpur's embassy district. Not the developer's website. Prices are indicative and depend on unit and availability.

## Contact
- WhatsApp / phone: +60 12-657 9508
- Website: https://www.d-rapport.com/

## Project facts
- Names: Cappella Embassy (current), D'Rapport Residences (former)
- Address: Jalan Nipah, off Jalan Ampang, Ampang Hilir, 55000 Kuala Lumpur
- Status: completed 2020 (ready units)
- Scale: 9.12 acres, 5 residential towers, 1,099 units (about 120 units per acre)
- Marketed by: TSLAW Land (formerly D'Rapport Residences by Acmar Group)
- Layouts: about 1,108 sq ft (2 bedrooms) to 2,260 sq ft (3+1 bedrooms, 4+1 bathrooms), including corner and dual-key layouts
- Indicative prices: from about RM 980,000 to about RM 2,120,000
- Facilities: 11,000 sq ft gym, indoor badminton arena, squash and basketball courts, Olympic-length lap pool, 38th-floor sky gardens with KLCC views, private cinema, elevated canopy forest walk
- Nearby: KLCC and Petronas Twin Towers, Royal Selangor Golf Club, international schools along Jalan Ampang, embassies

## FAQ
- Where is Cappella Embassy (formerly D'Rapport Residences) located? Cappella Embassy is on Jalan Nipah, off Jalan Ampang, in Ampang Hilir, Kuala Lumpur (postcode 55000), the diplomatic enclave a short drive from KLCC and the Petronas Twin Towers, with international schools and the Royal Selangor Golf Club nearby.
- Is Cappella Embassy completed? Yes. The development was completed in 2020, so units are ready for occupation rather than under construction.
- How large is the development and how many units are there? The estate covers 9.12 Acres with 1,099 units across five residential towers, about 120 units per acre.
- What unit sizes and layouts are available? Layouts range from about 1,108 sq ft two-bedroom suites to 2,260 sq ft three-plus-one-bedroom family residences with four-plus-one bathrooms, including corner and dual-key configurations.
- What are the prices at Cappella Embassy? Indicative prices start from about RM 980,000 for the two-bedroom suites and go up to about RM 2,120,000 for the largest family layouts. Prices depend on the unit, floor and current availability; ask for the latest list.
- What facilities does Cappella Embassy have? Residents have an 11,000 sq ft gym, an indoor badminton arena, squash and basketball courts, a resort-style Olympic-length lap pool, sky gardens on the 38th floor with KLCC views, a private cinema and an elevated canopy forest walk through the 9.12-acre grounds.
- Who developed Cappella Embassy? The project is marketed under TSLAW Land (formerly D'Rapport Residences by Acmar Group).
- How do I arrange a viewing? Use the registration form on this page or WhatsApp +60 12-657 9508 to book a private viewing and receive the current price list and floor plans.
